sam (People Ops): Quick Q&A drop: two small policy clarifications before we lock the cycle timeline. please read and react.

rachel (People Ops): First: manager handoffs when a manager leaves mid-cycle. We had a few asks last cycle.

toni (Manager - SRE): yep saw that. what's the official flow now?

sam (People Ops): Flow: outgoing manager marks 'handoff' in the manager form -> nominates interim manager -> interim gets edit access and an auto-email with required actions. If no interim nominated, People Ops assigns the director as interim.

ellie (Manager - Product): Edit access duration? we need time to collect context.

omar (People Ops - Systems): Interim access is for 14 days from the handoff date. If you need more, request a waiver form. Access logs will record all edits.

ton i (Manager - SRE): small ask: can we include a short 'handoff checklist' template in the email?

sam (People Ops): yes, added a 6-item checklist (goals, last 12mo highlights, outstanding projects, reviewer list, known calibration flags, evidence links).

rachel (People Ops): Second clarification: anonymous upward feedback that arrives after packets are locked. How do we surface it?

ellie (Manager - Product): We had a case where an IC submitted new upward feedback after packet lock and the rating changed.

omar (People Ops - Systems): Policy: new anonymous upward feedback is accepted until calibration opens. After calibration begins, anonymous submissions are logged and sent to People Ops for triage but not added to the packet unless it contains verifiable new evidence. Managers can attach a Manager's Addendum to note the new material; People Ops will surface serious concerns to the chair.

sam (People Ops): For clarity: "verifiable new evidence" means dated logs, code links, or documented incidents. Purely opinion-based notes won't be added post-lock.

ton i (Manager - SRE): What about on-call incidents that happened right before calibration? we often only have incident review docs after the fact.

omar (People Ops - Systems): If incident RCA is time-stamped and linked, we'll accept it as verifiable. Please attach the incident ticket ID in the Manager's Addendum.

ellie (Manager - Product): Will chairs be notified of these late additions?

rachel (People Ops): Yes chairs get a 'late evidence' summary email. If the new evidence materially changes recommended rating, the chair can request a short reconvene (max 24h) to consider.

sam (People Ops): Operational note: calendar reminders unchanged. Manager reviews due May 10 09:00 UTC. Manager reminder sends May 08 09:00 UTC.

reminder-bot: Event scheduled: Manager reviews due May 10 09:00 UTC. Reminder scheduled May 08 09:00 UTC.

ton i (Manager - SRE): Thanks. One more tiny ask: can People Ops include a short blurb we can paste into team syncs about how to handle on-call conflicts with deadlines?

omar (People Ops - Systems): I'll drop a 3-line blurb in the handbook and DM it to managers in #managers.

sam (People Ops): Thanks all. If there are edge cases, ping @rachel and @omar. :white_check_mark:
